title: Bani Utbah invasion of Bahrain
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Bani Utbah invasion of Bahrain", at revision 1370124446, opens: "The Bani Utbah invasion of Bahrain led to the end of Persian rule in Bahrain and the annexation of Bahrain by the Al Khalifa clan of the Bani Utbah." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4553250, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1782–83 war ending Persian rule". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
